description: Land Title Settlement Department - No 38 Raja Ela, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. The notices specifically address land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land parcels in various districts, and the process for determining land titles. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land registration, title claims, and property ownership matters.
